name: tracker-legacy-dispatch-rollback
goal: Fence legacy dispatcher rollback while native-owned work can still run, then preserve pinned legacy run rows and startup fingerprints on the same database.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Pinned legacy dispatcher starts queued runs using the current item token without understanding a native attempt key. Quiesce the native worker and refuse same-database legacy rollback until all native attempts are settled.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing claim and atomic transition method case checked legacy readers and invalidated native metadata; it did not exercise rollback admission for queued, running, verifying, and completed rows.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At ed68e8ea50 the existing SQLite claim case failed because assertLegacyRollbackSafe was absent. The checkpoint is b5a9d3b5fbc8.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Inspect native attempt metadata and fence rollback while a matching run is queued, running, or verifying. Finished and legacy-owned runs remain readable by both dispatchers.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged case passed at 8b744e63f5, checkpoint afdc59204515. The pinned Node SQLite rehearsal also settled the reserved run after reopen and verified legacy rollback on the same file.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
